title: Rimini Street Announces Upcoming 2026 Investor Events Schedule
summary: Today, Rimini Street announced its upcoming 2026 Investor Events Schedule, which includes participation in conferences such as Needham Co & TD Cowen.
body_markdown:
**LAS VEGAS, April 14, 2026 –**[Rimini Street, Inc.](https://www.riministreet.com/?utm_source=PressRelease&utm_medium=Referral&utm_campaign=2026InvestorEventsScheduleAnnouncement) (Nasdaq: RMNI), the Software Support and Agentic AI ERP Company™, and the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software, today announced the following upcoming 2026 Investor Events Schedule.


**Investor Conferences:**


[Michael Perica](https://www.riministreet.com/company/leadership/?utm_source=PressRelease&utm_medium=Referral&utm_campaign=2026InvestorEventsScheduleAnnouncement#michael-perica) , chief financial officer and[Dean Pohl](https://www.riministreet.com/company/leadership/?utm_source=PressRelease&utm_medium=Referral&utm_campaign=2026InvestorEventsScheduleAnnouncement#dean-pohl) , vice president, treasurer and investor relations, will participate in one-on-one and small group meetings and present in live webcast sessions as indicated below:


May 13 and 14, 2026: **Needham Co.** 21st Annual Technology, Media, & Consumer Conference, NYC


Presentation, May 13, 3:45 p.m. to 4:25 p.m. ET,[webcast link](https://event.summitcast.com/view/aZxVFEntdXZooQDEsVxUoT/ioNoAPsoBDN5KiUmqU4pkD)


May 27, 2026: **TD Cowen** 54th Annual Technology, Media & Telecom Conference, NYC


Fireside Chat, May 27, 10:50 a.m. to 11:20 a.m. ET,[webcast link](https://event.summitcast.com/view/GSXkFLqLwmvLB7AnnUj3ti/Tw4c23rCCA4ic7TWxetdAZ)


May 28, 2026: **Craig-Hallum** , 23rd Annual Institutional Investor Conference, Minneapolis, MN


To schedule a meeting, please contact your salesperson or Rimini Street IR at[\[email protected\]](https://www.riministreet.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#276e7567554e4a4e494e5453554242530944484a) . Visit[the Rimini Street investor relations site](https://investors.riministreet.com/events) for additional information, including the webcast links, regarding the Company and the upcoming events.
